purpose: R1.17.1 — Event-Relation Safety & Correctness corrections, exactly per the Posidon attachment and nothing more (no new capability, no Phase-5 scope claim). RED→GREEN evidence: all three counterexamples were reproduced on the untouched baseline e61bb46 (G1 {relationCalls:1,budgetDelta:1}; A1 {relationCalls:1,storedRunDelta:0}; D1 {elapsedMs:20000,relationCalls:1}; 3 failed / 10 skipped, exit 1) and are green after the corrections. (G1) The effective relation gate is the GLOBAL AI_ENABLED kill switch AND the independent EVENT_RELATION_ENABLED flag — BOTH fail-closed, enforced in TWO layers: the production wiring (resolveJobsEngine) passes the global gate into the relation service's config AND ANDs it into the handler's relation step, AND the service itself refuses directly on aiEnabled=false even for a wrongly-wired caller (typed deferred ai_disabled with ZERO calls, ZERO budget authorizations, ZERO usage writes). Permanent matrix: harness-level global false/true × relation false/true, PLUS real engine-env resolution tests with a native-binding stub and zero network (global OFF × relation ON never reaches the provider or the budget; global ON × relation OFF commits with the honest disabled ledger and zero relation calls; binding ABSENT defers typed with zero calls/charges; present-but-invalid flag values fail closed as config_invalid before the engine is built). (A1) ALL post-provider failure exits are audited: the FIRST commitEditorialResult throw is now caught — the atomic batch leaves zero editorial state, but the generation's REAL invocations (drafting AND any relation adjudication) are recorded best-effort through the fenced standalone ai_runs inserts with their DETERMINISTIC per-(job,generation,pair,attempt) ids and the own-row guard (no duplicates); the relation-step catch no longer assumes zero provider calls (it records whatever REAL rows were collected; a step that never reached the provider contributes zero fabricated rows); charges stay (never refunded); the next generation runs its OWN invocations and gets its OWN rows (no collision — generation-scoped deterministic ids; no misattribution — a used-by-nobody orphan run is never presented as consumed; no free lunch — the retry pays again). A persistent store outage can defeat the best-effort record: an honest limitation, never an invented exactly-once guarantee. The pre-existing scenario-4 expectation (commit-throw ⇒ ai_runs empty) is corrected to the new honest semantics with the recorded reason. (D1) The step's ABSOLUTE deadline is set at the START of the FIRST relation work — the entity probes INCLUDED — and holds from retrieval/basis packaging through budget authorization, provider call, output validation and usage: the handler computes it and passes it to the service, which can only SHORTEN its own local 15 s cap (never reset or extend; a non-finite supplied value is treated as absent and the local cap still bounds). Reads stop STARTING after expiry: no new entity probe starts (findStoryCandidatesByEntities grew an optional deadline guard; the shortfall is honestly folded into unprobedCount), no new basis read starts (the unread candidate is TYPED basis_unavailable with reason step_deadline_expired), and every pair after expiry is TYPED skipped_deadline with zero run rows — never a semantic verdict, never a fabricated basis claim. A pending D1 query is NOT cancellable: expiry frees the CALLER only (the bounded race / late-rejection-absorbing awaitWithDeadline primitive), never a claimed real cancellation. The pairs/attempt caps (≤2/≤3) and the separate drafting deadline stay untouched; permanent regression covers slow entity probe, slow first basis read, pending budget authorization, noncooperative provider, late rejection absorbed, expiry between pairs, and no-new-provider-start after the time budget — all with the injected fake clock/manual scheduler, ZERO real sleeps. Deferred-pair ledgers now carry the REAL self-side identity (sideA) instead of the old empty-evidence placeholder — the typed reader's strictness exposed the latent placeholder shape and the ledger now records the pair's own basis honestly. Tests: unit 41 (the service gates + the new R1.17.1 deadline block: already-expired supplied deadline, expiry between pairs, supplied-shortens-local-cap with the manual scheduler and late rejection absorbed, non-finite treated as absent) + integration 20 (the 10 R1.17 acceptance tests + the R1.17.1 G1/A1/D1 permanent regressions incl. the real engine-env wiring matrix and the multi-pair commit-throw audit before/after the retry).
